description_good_justification: The organization profile succinctly describes the project in profile/README.md as 'Foundational Go libraries + the apps built on top of them', outlining the libraries, apps, and naming conventions.
interact_justification: profile/README.md provides links to obtain and explore the framework libraries and apps, CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to contribute code, and feedback is received via GitHub Issues and SECURITY.md.
contribution_justification: The contribution process is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md, specifying pull requests, single-maintainer review criteria, signed commits, and Conventional Commits formatting: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
contribution_requirements_justification: Acceptable contribution requirements are defined in CONTRIBUTING.md, requiring signed commits with Signed-off-by trailers, Conventional Commits titles, and passing required checks under praetor-main-protection ruleset: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
floss_license_justification: The repository is licensed under the European Union Public Licence v. 1.2 (EUPL-1.2), an OSI- and FSF-approved FLOSS license, with Markdown prose licensed under CC-BY-SA-4.0 per REUSE.toml and LICENSE.
floss_license_osi_justification: The primary license of the repository, EUPL-1.2 in LICENSE, is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
license_location_justification: The license text is posted at the repository root in LICENSE, and individual license texts are maintained under LICENSES/EUPL-1.2.txt and LICENSES/CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt per the REUSE specification: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/LICENSE.
documentation_basics_justification: The repository does not produce software requiring installation or runtime instructions, providing organisation profile documentation and community health files only (Makefile, profile/README.md).
documentation_interface_justification: The repository does not produce software or an API library requiring external interface documentation, serving as an organisation documentation and community configuration repository as documented in Makefile and profile/README.md.
sites_https_justification: The repository URL (https://github.com/golusoris/.github) and all links within profile/README.md and REUSE.toml use HTTPS exclusively.
discussion_justification: Discussions, issues, and proposed changes are conducted via GitHub Issues and GitHub Pull Requests, which are public, searchable, URL-addressable, and accessible without proprietary software (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01: has_issues: true; CONTRIBUTING.md).
english_justification: All documentation, community files, and guidelines including profile/README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and SECURITY.md are written in English.
maintained_justification: The repository is actively maintained with commits and merged pull requests through October 2026 recorded in git log and GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01 (pushed_at: 2026-10-25T14:10:49Z, prs merged: 7).
repo_public_justification: The Git source code repository is publicly accessible at https://github.com/golusoris/.github as verified in GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01.
repo_track_justification: Git tracks commit authors, committers, and timestamps, with commit signatures enforced by GitHub ruleset praetor-main-protection (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01).
repo_interim_justification: The repository tracks granular interim commits and development branches merged via pull requests rather than only publishing final releases (git log, GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01: prs merged: 7).
repo_distributed_justification: The project uses Git, an open-source distributed version control system, hosted on GitHub.
version_unique_justification: Each repository revision and release state is uniquely identified by its Git commit SHA (git log).
version_semver_justification: The repository does not publish versioned releases or use SemVer/CalVer version numbers, relying solely on Git commit identifiers (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01: 0 releases and 0 tags).
version_tags_justification: The repository does not contain Git tags identifying releases (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01: 0 tags; git tag produces no output).
release_notes_justification: N/A: the repository publishes no releases (0 releases, 0 tags, read 2026-11-08) because nothing consumes a release. GitHub serves the organisation profile and community health files from the default branch, and the reusable label workflow is called at @main and fetches labels.yml from main, so the files are continuously updated and deployed to one place, the case this criterion allows N/A for. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/sync-labels.yml
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release notes exist and no publicly known run-time vulnerabilities have been reported for this repository (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01: dependabot open: 0, releases: 0).
report_process_justification: Bug reports and issues are submitted via GitHub Issues as referenced in CONTRIBUTING.md and verified in GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01 (has_issues: true): https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
report_tracker_justification: The project uses GitHub Issues to track defects, tasks, and requests individually (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01: has_issues: true).
report_responses_justification: No bug report was submitted in the last 12 months; the only issue (#1, opened 2026-04-18) is a task filed by the maintainer, not a bug report (GitHub API, read 2026-11-01).
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement request from anyone other than the maintainer was submitted in the last 12 months; the only issue (#1) is a maintainer-filed task (GitHub API, read 2026-11-01).
report_archive_justification: All submitted issues, comments, and pull requests are publicly and permanently archived on GitHub Issues as referenced in CONTRIBUTING.md: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability reporting process is published in SECURITY.md, directing reporters to email security@lusoris.dev or submit private security advisories with response commitments within 72 hours: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md gives a private channel by email (security@lusoris.dev). GitHub private vulnerability reporting is disabled in the repository settings, so the email is the working private channel.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report was received in the last 6 months (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01: dependabot open: 0; no security advisories), and SECURITY.md commits to initial acknowledgement within 72 hours.
build_justification: The repository contains organisation profile documentation and community health files that require no compilation or build steps to use, as codified in Makefile (build target prints 'not applicable: this repository holds organisation profile and community files only; nothing compiles').
build_common_tools_justification: No build toolchain is required to use the files in this repository (Makefile: build target is not applicable).
build_floss_tools_justification: No build tools are needed to use this repository's profile and configuration files (Makefile: build target is not applicable).
test_justification: An automated test suite under tests/ (Python unittest) checks the files the repository publishes: labels.yml against the format EndBug/label-sync reads, the .bestpractices.json answers, and the relative links of the rendered Markdown files, each with planted-defect and boundary cases. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/tree/main/tests
test_invocation_justification: make test runs the suite in tests/ with the standard command python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v, and make verify-all runs it with the other checks. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/Makefile
test_most_justification: The suite in tests/ checks every published data file and every rendered Markdown file, but coverage is not measured: no coverage tool runs, so no figure is claimed. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/Makefile
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The Tests workflow runs make test (tests/) on every pull request, on main and in the merge queue. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml
test_policy_justification: README.md states the test policy: a change that adds a published file, or a rule for one, adds a test to tests/ in the same pull request with a passing case, a refused planted defect and the boundary between them, and a fix adds a test that fails without it. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/README.md#tests
tests_are_added_justification: Pull request 12 added the suite in tests/ together with a passing, a planted-defect and a boundary test for every check it introduced, and the README test policy requires the same of every later change. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/pull/12
tests_documented_added_justification: Instructions for change proposals in CONTRIBUTING.md do not document a policy requiring automated tests.
warnings_justification: The project enforces automated linting in CI using reuse lint (.github/workflows/reuse.yml) and defines workflow linting rules in .github/actionlint.yaml and formatting rules in .editorconfig.
warnings_fixed_justification: Linter warnings and compliance failures must be fixed before merge, as REUSE lint is enforced as a required status check in .github/rulesets/main.json and GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01.
warnings_strict_justification: The repository applies strict linting rules, requiring zero REUSE licensing errors in .github/workflows/reuse.yml and enforcing pre-commit hook checks in lefthook.yml.
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer applies least privilege and protected history: workflows declare minimal token permissions, and .github/rulesets/main.json requires signed commits, linear history and passing checks, with a pull-request-only bypass for one repository role (CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md).
know_common_errors_justification: The primary developer understands common vulnerability classes and supply chain risks for repository configurations, implementing automated OSSF Scorecard analysis (.github/workflows/scorecard.yml) and push protection (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01).
crypto_published_justification: The repository does not implement or produce software using cryptographic capabilities, containing only organisation profile and community health files (Makefile).
crypto_call_justification: The repository is not an application or library implementing cryptographic functions (Makefile).
crypto_floss_justification: The repository produces no software that depends on cryptographic functionality (Makefile).
crypto_keylength_justification: The repository contains no software with cryptographic mechanisms or keylength configurations (Makefile).
crypto_working_justification: The repository does not implement or use cryptographic algorithms (Makefile).
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The repository does not implement or use cryptographic algorithms or cipher modes (Makefile).
crypto_pfs_justification: The repository does not implement network key agreement protocols or session key management (Makefile).
crypto_password_storage_justification: The repository does not store passwords or authenticate external users (Makefile).
crypto_random_justification: The repository does not generate cryptographic keys or nonces (Makefile).
delivery_mitm_justification: Repository content and workflows are delivered exclusively over HTTPS and Git over SSH via GitHub (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01: html_url: https://github.com/golusoris/.github).
delivery_unsigned_justification: CI installs the REUSE tool from .config/reuse/requirements.txt with pinned sha256 hashes checked by pip; actions are pinned by commit SHA; no hash is fetched over HTTP.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No known medium-or-higher vulnerability is open: zero open Dependabot alerts and zero security advisories; the only open code-scanning alert is the Scorecard CIIBestPracticesID check (severity low), read 2026-11-01.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been reported: zero security advisories and zero open Dependabot alerts (GitHub API, read 2026-11-01).
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and secret scanning push protection are actively enabled on the repository (GitHub repository settings read 2026-11-01), and no private credentials exist in the Git repository.
static_analysis_justification: Static analysis is performed automatically in CI using OSSF Scorecard (.github/workflows/scorecard.yml), analyzing repository security configurations and GitHub Actions workflows with results uploaded as SARIF to GitHub Code Scanning, enforced as a required check in .github/rulesets/main.json.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: OSSF Scorecard specifically tests for common supply chain and repository vulnerabilities including dangerous workflow patterns, unpinned actions, branch protection rules, and token permissions (.github/workflows/scorecard.yml).
static_analysis_fixed_justification: No medium-or-higher static analysis finding is open: the only open code-scanning alert is the Scorecard CIIBestPracticesID check (severity low, no code location), read 2026-11-01.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis via OSSF Scorecard executes on every push and pull request to the main branch (.github/workflows/scorecard.yml).
dynamic_analysis_justification: No dynamic analysis tool, fuzzer, or 80% coverage test suite is executed, as this repository contains community health files and documentation rather than executable software (Makefile).
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The repository does not produce software written in a memory-unsafe language, containing only Markdown documentation, YAML configuration, and shell/python governance scripts.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No dynamic analysis tool runs; the suite in tests/ checks data and Markdown files, not executable software, so no run-time assertions apply. Evidence: https://github.com/golusoris/.github/blob/main/Makefile
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis is run for this repository and consequently no vulnerabilities have been discovered via dynamic analysis (Makefile).
